description.en-US: More's early English verses on Lady Fortune, written in the Tudor household of Cardinal Morton.

sources.edition: The boke of the fayre gentylwoman, EEBO-TCP A07691.
sources.description: EEBO-TCP hand-keyed transcription, original spelling kept. 208 illegible places in the source are marked […]. Raw TEI in sources/en-US-originals/.
